decisions.reason: It stayed prominently presented through 2024 and, for a large German space-systems firm with slack and long mission sales cycles, that suggests performance is at least near aspiration and worth continuing.
The dedicated presentation plus the ESA HERA flight result put this product clearly above aspiration, so management would retain and leverage it.
Because it remained a standalone offer in 2024 and fits the firm's core capabilities and future market direction, the firm would keep it while demand and mission opportunities mature.

Although market signals are weaker because it was only mentioned, its strong fit with the firm's miniaturization trajectory and the firm's R&D slack make continued support more likely than withdrawal.
As a 2024 launch with its own page in a reliability-critical niche close to the core business, it is too early and too strategically aligned to drop.
This is a very recent adjacent product in a long-cycle space market, so a boundedly rational management with available slack would keep it on the market while learning from early mission demand.
